title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World, March 6
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with soloist Fiona Shea, and Dvorak's New World Symphony. The program follows Dvorak's call for American composers to draw on African American music and showcases the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO, with tickets sold through HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
